fab.$description: Floating action button — one round, icon-only button that floats over the page in a fixed corner and opens the one thing that should be reachable from anywhere (the CX Assistant). Its colours and states ARE Button primary's (resolved from button.tokens.json, never re-declared), so a primary retune reaches it; what it owns is the shape, size, elevation and the corner it sits in. One per screen at most. Promoted from the CX shell's local .cx-fab on 2026-10-26 (user: 'FAB кнопку треба додати саме як фаб'). Always needs an aria-label (there is no visible text) and a native title.

size.$description: 48px on every width (user, 2026-10-20 — 64, then 56, were too big).

iconSize.$description: 24px — half the diameter, the same 50% rule Button's icons follow.

shadow.$description: The one button with elevation: it floats over content, so it needs to read as above it. Same tier as SlideOverPanel.

offset.$description: 24px from the right and bottom edges (plus the safe-area inset) from 768px up.
